payload.title: Implement Console target resolver
payload.description:
Implement deterministic Console score target resolution and tests.

Implementation notes:
- Add a runtime score resolve API for unique, ambiguous, and missing targets.
- Teach Console orchestration to consume a prior disambiguation answer once.
- Preserve score edit and guidelines validation safety boundaries.
- Prove with targeted tests and live Console smoke evidence.

No client-specific names or score identifiers are stored here.
